The '''Frostbite Redoubt''' was a [[Talz/Legends|Talz]] fortification inside a cave system in the [[Windchapped Ridge]] on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], during the [[Galactic War]]. An [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] individual infiltrated the bunker and found the corpse of the missing [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Vannis]], [[Dorn Base]]'s commander.
